title: The REQUEST governs for a percentage: a percentage-of-amount charge whose m_charge.amount is 1.2345% is charged 0.5% of 1,200,000.00 = 6,000.00 when the request supplies 0.5.
_note: Closes the 'definition vs request' blindness for a percentage-of-amount charge. The persisted percentage (1.2345%) is ignored; the observed feeChargesDue on the disbursement row is 6000.000 (value 6000.00), i.e. 0.5% of the disbursed principal 1,200,000.00.

provenance.note: TRANSCRIBED, never computed, from the T46 capture T46-CH-06. fee_minor 600000 is the exact major->minor scaling of the observed 6000.000 (value 6000.00); base_amount_minor 120000000 is the exact scaling of the disbursed principal 1,200,000.00; percentage 500000 is 0.5% in micro-per-cent.
